description: Find step-by-step instructions for a common job, written for you to follow with these tools: cutting the pauses, ums and restarts out of a talking video, for one. Search in the user's words: the skills that fit come back, best first. When none fits, or with no query, the answer is the list of every skill, a page at a time, to choose from by description. Read one with skills.get, then follow its Steps.

offset.description: Where a page of the list starts: the next_offset of the page before

query.description: What the user wants done, in their words, e.g. "remove the ums from my video". Without it, the list of every skill

name: skills.search

matched.description: true: these skills fit the query, best first; false: none did, and this is a page of every skill

next_offset.description: offset for the next page; null on the last

total.description: Skills in the whole answer, across its pages

title: Find a skill
